hooks.command: bash .claude/scripts/session_start.sh 2>/dev/null || echo 'Session start script not found'

bash -c 'MODIFIED=$(git -C /Users/macbook/Documents/combaretrovamiauto-enterprise diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); UNTRACKED=$(git -C /Users/macbook/Documents/combaretrovamiauto-enterprise ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); if [ "$MODIFIED" = "0" ] && [ "$UNTRACKED" = "0" ]; then exit 0; else echo "Reminder: $MODIFIED modified + $UNTRACKED untracked. Considera aggiornare memory/MEMORY.md se cambiamenti significativi."; exit 0; fi'
